title: Harden web request helpers: opt-in default credentials
summary: Http Web Request Mgt. and SOAP Web Service Request Mgt. now disable default credentials by default and require callers to opt in with SetUseDefaultCredentials(true) for on-premises installations, preventing unintended transmission of Business Central service account credentials to external hosts.
key_points: Default credentials are turned off by default in Http Web Request Mgt. and SOAP Web Service Request Mgt.
New SetUseDefaultCredentials(Boolean) method allows callers to opt in to sending default credentials for on-premises environments.
Fault-response trace logging is disabled by default in Http Web Request Mgt. and must be explicitly enabled.
Extension Marketplace never sends default credentials, only the AppSource telemetry callback.
Existing test libraries and local BC server calls opt in to default credentials to maintain Windows authentication support.
